# U.S. News Travel

> > Comprehensive travel rankings, destination guides, and vacation planning resources for top destinations across the USA, Canada, Asia, and Mexico.

U.S. News Travel provides expert-curated rankings of the best cities and vacation destinations worldwide, along with interactive maps, neighborhood guides, and detailed travel planning information for popular locations including Quebec City, Sedona, San Miguel de Allende, Alaska, and major destinations across North America and Asia.

- Travel Rankings
- Destination Guides
- Vacation Planning
- U.S. Cities
- Canada Travel

- Day Trips
- Mexico Travel

## Travel Rankings

- [20 Best U.S. Cities to Visit in 2026](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/best-cities-usa/): Ranked list of top 20 U.S. cities to visit in 2026 with travel insights
- [Asia Destinations: Rankings](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/asia/): Ranked guide to best Asia vacation spots including Kyoto and Mount Fuji
- [Canada Destinations: Rankings](https://travel.usnews.com/rankings/canada/): Ranked list of top Canada destinations including Banff and Quebec City

## Interactive Destination Maps

- [Quebec City Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/Quebec_City_Canada/Area_Map/): Interactive map showing Quebec City hotels and attractions locations
- [Sedona Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/Sedona_AZ/Area_Map/): Interactive map of Sedona, AZ showing hotels and attractions
- [San Miguel de Allende Area Map](https://travel.usnews.com/San_Miguel_de_Allende_Mexico/Area_Map/): Map guide to San Miguel de Allende hotels and attractions in Mexico
